title: Poster Presentation at Gordon Research Conference (GRC) – Catalysis, USA
summary: Presented our latest DFT and machine-learned interatomic potential (MLIP) insights on transition-metal sulfide & oxide electrocatalysts at GRC Catalysis. Open to full-time Computational Materials & AI-for-Science roles starting Summer 2027.

title: Usefulness Boundary Hub (osi-mlips) — Open Scientific Intelligence Hackathon #147
summary: Co-built a multi-lens MLIP evaluation hub mapping MACE and NequIP usefulness boundaries across Descriptive failure modes, Mechanistic notes, and Bayesian UQ with a grounded model recommender.

title: Team AtomInfer — Agent Turning Experimental Data into Atomic Structures
summary: Built an agentic web platform (FastAPI + Three.js + HRMC) with Anirban Phukan and Nishant Mishra to parse experimental XRD/Raman spectra, query Materials Project, and output simulation-ready structures.

title: Comprehensive Water Electrolysis Catalyst Design Review Published in Small
summary: First-author review with Dr. Nelson Y. Dzade synthesized rational electronic-structure modulation, active-site engineering, and computational design rules for durable green hydrogen electrocatalysts.

title: International Oral Presentation at 5th International Solar Fuels Conference (ISF-5)
summary: Delivered an international oral presentation in the UK showcasing computational discovery, doping strategies, and explicit solvation dynamics of photocatalytic and electrocatalytic water-splitting materials.

title: Oral Talk at NAM29 (USA) & Frank J. Vastola Graduate Scholarship
summary: Presented oral research on catalyst surface reaction mechanisms at the 29th North American Catalysis Society Meeting (NAM29) and received Penn State's Frank J. and Ruth J. St. Clair Vastola Graduate Scholarship.

title: Metal-Center Redox Mechanisms in FeMn(NbTa)2O6 Columbite for AEM Electrolyzers
summary: Published in Advanced Energy Materials elucidating metal-center intermediate adsorption thermodynamics and redox switching mechanisms enabling durable Anion Exchange Membrane Water Electrolyzers (AEMWE).

title: 1st Place Student Poster at Hydrogen Americas Summit & 2x Best Presentation Honors
summary: Awarded First Place in the Student Poster Presentation at the Hydrogen Americas 2024 Summit & Exhibition following Second Place in Penn State's 2023 Graduate Research Exhibition Video Competition.
